content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents, then read candidate_specs.md and any detector/gas-system requirements documents needed. Extract the three allowed gas mixtures, their component fractions, GWP100 values, any stated operating constraints, and the allowed gap range 1–3 mm."},{"id":"s2","description":"Screen the three candidate mixtures against the hard GWP100 requirement. Keep only mixtures with GWP100 <= 150 for simulation, and note any candidates excluded for exceeding the environmental limit."},{"id":"s3","description":"For each GWP-compliant candidate mixture, run simulate_time_resolution at representative gas gaps covering the allowed range: 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, and 3.0 mm. Record the returned numeric time resolutions for comparison."},{"id":"s4","description":"Identify the candidate mixture and gap region with the best simulated time resolution. If the best point is near the interior of the scanned range, run additional simulations around it in finer gap increments, e.g. ±0.1–0.25 mm, while staying within 1–3 mm. Record all numeric time-resolution results."},{"id":"s5","description":"Select the single mixture and gas gap with the lowest simulated time resolution among candidates satisfying both hard requirements: time resolution <= 1.5 ns and GWP100 <= 150. Prepare the result for the reporting module, including the chosen mixture, chosen gap, simulated time resolution, and GWP100, and flag if no candidate satisfies the hard requirements."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Mixture-G2","gap_mm":2.2,"justification":"Mixture-G2 at a 2.20 mm gas gap gives the best simulated time resolution among all tested candidate/gap combinations: 0.869 ns, tied with 2.25 mm and comfortably better than the 1.5 ns hard requirement. The gap is within the allowed 1–3 mm range. However, the recorded results show that GWP100 screening data were not available, so compliance with the hard GWP100 ≤ 150 requirement cannot be verified from the available evidence; this recommendation is therefore the best time-resolution choice conditional on confirming the mixture's GWP100 compliance.","requirements":[{"requirement":"Achieve the best possible time resolution.","status":"met","evidence":"Best simulated result is Mixture-G2 at 2.20–2.25 mm with time resolution 0.869 ns; selected 2.20 mm."},{"requirement":"The mixture must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.","status":"met","evidence":"Selected option is Mixture-G2, one of the three allowed candidates."},{"requirement":"The time resolution must be 1.5 ns or better.
